Question Choices: Which number has more two-factor multiplication facts using positive whole numbers, 12 or 16? Count reversed facts separately.
Solution: Using positive whole numbers and counting reversed facts separately, 12 has six facts: 1 x 12, 2 x 6, 3 x 4 and their reverses. Sixteen has five: 1 x 16, 2 x 8, 4 x 4, 8 x 2, 16 x 1. Therefore 12 has more.
